title: A shot in the dark: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 58
content:
## A shot in the dark

**Word Power 58 · English idioms**

### Meaning

A wild or random guess.

### Usage

1. His answer was only a shot in the dark, but luckily it was correct.
2. My last five answers were only a shot in the dark. I didn't know the correct answers.

### How to use it

A shot in the dark is a guess made with little useful information. It differs from an educated guess based on clear evidence. Use the article a before shot when introducing a single guess.

### Another example

I had never seen the word before, so my answer was a shot in the dark.

### Check your understanding

Complete: With no clues at all, choosing option B was a shot ___ the dark.

### Suggested answer

In. The phrase describes the lack of reliable information behind the guess, not an actual shot or a dark room.
